items.title: Nomic extends AI agents into CAD drafting and BIM
items.excerpt: Nomic's AI drawing-review platform now drafts too: describe a drawing in natural language or supply one for revision and the agent returns an editable DWG/DXF file plus a plotted PDF, following company CAD standards (layers, line weights, hatching, dimension styles), and works directly inside Revit and AutoCAD.

items.title: Meet MAGI-2: Sand AI's New Video Model With Built-In Sound, Exclusively on Higgsfield
items.excerpt: Sand AI's MAGI-2 video model lands exclusively on Higgsfield, generating video and synchronized sound together in 4-30 second clips at 1080p, with reference inputs, settings and pricing documented for creators.

items.title: Higgsfield GPU Harness: Cloud GPUs for Blender, ArtCraft and open models, driven from Claude or ChatGPT
items.excerpt: Higgsfield now rents NVIDIA GPU machines (L40S to B300, 71-197 credits/hour, per-second billing) that open with Blender Studio or ArtCraft ready, and an agent installs Unreal, Houdini, Nuke or Resolve; artists drive the machines through Claude, ChatGPT or Higgsfield Supercomputer. A 62-frame 1080p Cycles render took under 7 minutes on one L40S.

items.title: NVIDIA releases open weights for Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B, an image model that also outputs editable SVG/HTML structure
items.excerpt: NVIDIA published the public release snapshot of Nemotron-Labs-Image, a 30B (3B active) autoregressive text-to-image model whose shared interface generates both raster images and editable structure (SVG, HTML/CSS, plots, document markup); NVIDIA's benchmarks put it ahead of GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro on GenEval and text-rendering tests.

items.title: Canva opens design tools to AI agents and developers
items.excerpt: Canva made its rebuilt MCP server generally available and launched new APIs, service accounts and a CLI so outside agents can create editable designs, images and short videos, remove backgrounds, layer flat images and resize/export, with its Craft image model exposed via API and MCP; Canva also becomes the design layer inside Claude. (Off-list source: canva.com newsroom 403s. Check marketing-section dup.)

items.title: MCP servers can now ship skills, run tasks, and more with Claude
items.excerpt: Skills over MCP is in public beta in Claude, so MCP servers (including design-tool servers) can ship skills alongside their tools; Tasks and Elicitation are now generally available and File Uploads is rolling out. The Decoder reports MCP SDK downloads topped 700 million a month.

items.title: Crystal Palace tried to get away with posting AI and fans tore it to shreds
items.excerpt: The Premier League club posted an AI-generated image of its Selhurst Park stadium and fans picked apart its errors, the latest brand backlash over sloppy generative imagery in official creative.

items.title: Designing for the AI agent customer
items.excerpt: A UX Collective piece on designing experiences when the 'customer' is a personal AI agent shopping on a user's behalf: what agent-readable interfaces, structured product data and trust signals mean for UX and digital marketing. (Member-only essay.)

items.title: The design process is changing. Are we asking the right questions?
items.excerpt: Designer Mihai Balea revisits his circular-design MVP model for AI-native product design: when an agent can map journeys, generate a working prototype and flag usability issues before the coffee's done, the linear process becomes a networked system with human judgment at the center.

items.title: Anthropic study shows the hardest part of adopting AI at work has little to do with learning the tools
items.excerpt: Anthropic studied nearly 300 AI deployments across 58 US companies; nearly one in five still delivers no business value, held back by heavy review workloads and organizational friction rather than tool skills. Relevant to design-org AX rollouts, but not design-specific.

items.title: See what 5 builders are making with Gemini 4 Neon
items.excerpt: Google showcases creative-coding builds made with Gemini 4 Neon in Antigravity: a glowing 3D Earth, Three.js butterflies, a hexagon flame shader, an interactive black-hole shader and a 3D pendulum-wave simulation. (Showcase post, not a launch.)

items.title: How Cozey turns its operators into software builders on Vercel
items.excerpt: Furniture maker Cozey has warehouse, finance and support staff building internal apps with coding agents and deploying them on Vercel (a live warehouse floor plan, a weekly P&L tool); six projects including the storefront use AI Gateway, and Vercel Flags replaced an ~$80K/year tool.

items.title: Amap Releases ABot-World 0.5 Iris Weights for Interactive Video
items.excerpt: Alibaba's Amap released 5B-parameter Iris weights from its ABot-World 0.5 world model for interactive, controllable video/scene generation; the larger Halo audio-video model stays separate. (Off-list: no vr-domain item this window.)

items.title: Picsart launches generative AI model hub for developers (30+ providers, 250 templates)
items.excerpt: Picsart opened its platform's AI to developers and businesses as a unified hub bundling image and video models from about 30 providers and 250 templates behind one API, targeting fragmentation as new models ship every few weeks. (Korean, off-list.)

items.title: Lovable changelog: Paper design-tool connector reads and edits your Paper canvas; ElevenLabs models for app AI features
items.excerpt: Nov 23: Paper, a design tool, became a prebuilt Lovable chat connector, so Lovable can read design context from Paper files and create or edit designs on the Paper canvas while building; Nov 25 added ElevenLabs speech and music models for app features. (Changelog base URL was published 2026-07-10; dedup may collide.)

items.title: 5 Best Claude Skills for Designers in 2026
items.excerpt: Builder.io rounds up the Claude skills its team uses for design work, with exact commands: Impeccable for UI polish, /remix for inspiration, Emil Kowalski's motion skill and more. (Listicle/how-to.)

items.title: Pin agent border-radius to the existing radius tokens - no magic rounded values
items.excerpt: A follow-up to the spacing-scale post (carded 11-24): constraining coding agents to existing radius tokens instead of arbitrary rounded values. Same author/series, deprioritized.

items.title: Making AI Work in UX Design: A DesignOps Perspective
items.excerpt: LexisNexis Design argues AI-generated UI can look convincing yet miss user needs, design-system standards or accessibility, and sets out four DesignOps areas: understanding designers' work, connecting AI to the design system, supporting learning, and clarifying responsibility. (Essay; same team carded 11-24.)

items.title: Here are 4 things you didn't know you could do with Gemini Canvas
items.excerpt: Google's tips for Gemini Canvas: build web apps, create custom study tools and refine writing side by side in the canvas workspace. (Tips post, low novelty.)

items.title: Generative AI and XR extend art activities for seniors: Immersive Lab's 'Onmalgeum' field-tested in Hwasun
items.excerpt: Immersive Lab field-tested 'Onmalgeum', which pairs generative AI with XR for art activities for older adults, as a case of designing AI/XR experiences for a generation unused to digital devices. (Korean, off-list.)

items.title: How to build an AI content generator for Webflow
items.excerpt: Webflow tutorial: build a guarded AI content generator on Webflow Cloud that writes OpenAI drafts into the CMS with an access key, preset tones and draft-only saves. (How-to, low priority.)
